title: 第286章 辞室韦扬鞭就道，入铁骊探险临疆
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

岳大鹏被莫敦突如其来的叫骂惊得一愣，浓眉倒竖，按上刀柄。

“直娘贼！翻脸不认人啊？真当爷爷手里的刀不利吗！”

陈醉按住岳大鹏手腕，暗暗使了几分力道。

他顺势侧过身，将岳大鹏挡在身前，背对着苍狼卫低语道：

“逢场作戏，莫要露底！”

言罢，陈醉大声呵斥道：

“罢了！大鹏！人家死心塌地，要给天狼人当看门狗，咱们还能上赶着贴这冷屁股不成？”

陈醉连连摇头，拉着岳大鹏便往石阶下退走：

“走走走！回去如实禀明千户大人，咱们不在这儿讨嫌了！”

陈醉手忙脚乱地去踩马镫，翻了几番，才狼狈翻上马背。

不远处的苍狼卫，见着宁使抱头鼠窜的德行，登时一阵哄笑。

苍狼卫百夫长眼底轻蔑之色愈浓。

见陈醉与岳大鹏拨转马头欲走。

百夫长缰绳一抖，跨马上前两步，镔铁长矛，遥遥指向岳大鹏胯下白马。

“慢着！”

百夫长厉声冷喝：

“南朝狗，想滚可以。但雪里青，必须给老子留下！”

岳大鹏本就憋着一肚子火，听闻此言，刚压下去的火星子再度点燃。

“留你娘的腿！”

“有种自己过来牵，爷爷倒要看看你的脖子够不够硬！”

苍狼卫闻声而动，几十号人齐齐抽刀半寸，杀气逼向阶前。

巡防营斥候纷纷摸向腰间连弩。

“诸位天狼兄弟，且慢动手！”

莫敦见势不妙，慌忙奔下石阶，张臂挡在苍狼卫与大宁游骑之间。

莫敦冲着天狼百夫长连连作揖：

“国主与忽都大人在殿内相谈甚欢。国主已备下丰盛鹿肉与烈酒，迎诸位天狼勇士入内廷偏殿饮宴！”

百夫长眉头微皱，矛尖不肯放下：

“这南朝贼子……”

莫敦赶紧凑上前去，仰起头，压低声音，在百夫长耳畔耳语道：

“将军息怒。在此杀将起来，恐怕宁人日后来寻我室韦麻烦。更何况刀剑无眼，若是乱战中伤了特穆尔王子的爱马，回去如何向王子交代？”

莫敦拍着胸脯，信誓旦旦：

“宁军已与我室韦撕破脸，国主已做了安排，到了荒郊野外，我室韦林中多的是善伏击的弓弩手，自会帮诸位兄弟将他们射杀！”

“到时马匹自然毫发无损地送归使团。”

百夫长听罢这番合情合理的盘算，终于打消了疑虑。

他斜睨了岳大鹏一眼，收回长矛，对着身后的苍狼卫一招手：

“走，先进去赴宴！”

数十名苍狼卫翻身下马，将马匹拴在宫墙外的木桩上，跟着莫敦大摇大摆地跨入了额尔木王宫。

岳大鹏坐在雪里青上，看着没入宫门的天狼兵，往地上重重啐了一口。

“呸！”

Page (1/3)

Yue Dapeng was startled by Mo Dun's sudden scolding, his thick eyebrows were raised, and he pressed the handle of the knife.

"Straight bitch! Are you turning your back on me? Is it really bad for you to be the knife in grandpa's hand!"

Chen Zui held Yue Dapeng's wrist and secretly exerted some force.

He turned sideways, blocked Yue Dapeng in front of him, turned his back to the Canglang Guard and whispered:

"Just make fun of yourself, don't show your bottom!"

After saying this, Chen Zui shouted loudly:

"That's it! Dapeng! He is determined to serve as a watchdog for the Sirius people, how can we rush to stick to this cold ass?"

Chen Zui shook his head repeatedly, pulled Yue Dapeng and retreated down the stone steps:

"Let's go! Go back and tell Lord Qianhu the truth, we won't be a nuisance here anymore!"

Chen Zui hurriedly stepped on the stirrups several times before he climbed onto the horse in embarrassment.

The Canglang Guards not far away burst into laughter when they saw Ning Shi's virtue of running away with his head in his arms.

The contempt in the eyes of the Centurion of the Canglang Guard became even stronger.

I saw Chen Zui and Yue Dapeng turning their horses' heads to leave.

The centurion shook his reins, took two steps forward astride his horse, and pointed his iron spear at the white horse at Yue Dapeng's crotch from afar.

"Wait!"

The centurion shouted coldly:

"Nan Chao Gou, you can get out if you want. But Xue Li Qing must stay with me!"

Yue Dapeng was already simmering with anger, but after hearing these words, the sparks he had just suppressed ignited again.

"Save your mother's legs!"

"If you dare, come and hold it yourself. Grandpa wants to see if your neck is strong enough!"

The Canglang Guards moved upon hearing the sound. Dozens of them drew their swords half an inch in unison, and moved toward the steps with murderous intent.

The patrol battalion scouts reached for their crossbows one after another.

"Brothers Sirius, please wait a moment!"

Seeing that the situation was not going well, Mo Dun hurriedly ran down the stone steps and opened his arms to stand between the Canglang Guards and Daning Rangers.

Mo Dun bowed repeatedly to the Sirius Centurion:

"The King of the Kingdom and Lord Hudu were having a great conversation in the palace. The King of the Kingdom has prepared a sumptuous supply of venison and strong wine to welcome all the Sirius warriors to a side hall of the inner court for a banquet!"

The centurion frowned slightly and refused to put down the tip of his spear:

"This Southern thief..."

Mo Dun quickly stepped forward, raised his head, lowered his voice, and whispered in the centurion's ear:

"General, calm down. If we kill the general here, I'm afraid Ning people will cause trouble for me, Shiwei, in the future. What's more, the sword has no eyes. If Prince Temur's beloved horse is injured in the chaos, how will he explain it to the prince when he goes back?"

Mo Dun patted his chest and vowed:

"Ning Jun has broken up with my Wei Wei, and the king has made arrangements. In the wilderness, there are many archers and crossbowmen in my Wei Lin who are good at ambush, and I will help you brothers to kill them!"

"The horses will naturally be returned to the mission unscathed by then."

After hearing this reasonable calculation, the centurion finally gave up his doubts.

He glanced sideways at Yue Dapeng, retracted his spear, and waved to Canglang Weiyi behind him:

"Let's go to the banquet first!"

Dozens of Canglang Guards dismounted, tied their horses to wooden stakes outside the palace wall, and followed Mo Dun into the Ermu Palace.

Yue Dapeng sat on the green grass in the snow, looked at the Sirius soldiers who had entered the palace gate, and spat heavily on the ground.

"Bah!"
